description.narrative:
Project Outcomes Grade-A warehouses involve large, modern, flexible and well-located buildings with adequate service infrastructure, constructed to optimize distribution configurations, and facilitate scale, throughput and consolidation of inventories and transportation. By offering transport services and simplifying distribution, Grade-A warehouses provide around 35 percent savings on a per-unit basis compared to Grade-B warehousing, thus increasing return on investment for tenants and improving the economic attractiveness of their investments in a target location. 80 percent of the current industrial and warehousing supply in Morocco is of low quality, inadequately managed, and geographically concentrated. The Project will significantly increase the availability of integrated 3PL services through building Grade-A warehousing space and expanding its transport network in Morocco directly addressing the access gap. Furthermore, global firms (3PL clients) are required to monitor and reduce their carbon footprint across their supply chain, which entails they will seek logistics service providers with environmental management measures.
Market Outcomes Access to high quality and efficient 3PL services can be instrumental to the productivity of services and manufacturing firms and can influence firms decisions to invest or expand in a given country. The 3PL market in Morocco is nascent, with very few players providing integrated transport and warehousing services. The Project is expected to consolidate the market through the acquisition of smaller logistics operators and reallocate these assets to more productive use, by a Company with improved managerial and technological capabilities. As BLS gains further market share, its advanced digital capabilities can set the industrys quality standards, and its commercial success can potentially incentivize new entrants to the market.

The proposed transaction is an equity investment of up to US$36 million in primary common shares of Building Logistics S.A (BLS or the Company). BLS is a logistics service provider in Morocco and a subsidiary of H&S Invest Holding, a diversified family-owned holding company operating in FMCG, logistics, pharmaceuticals, media communication and real estate. The Company has ambitious growth plans to become a leading third-party logistics (3PL) services provider in the country. IFCs proposed investment will be used to finance BLS growth investments consisting of (i) bolt-on acquisitions of identified logistics service providers, warehouse facilities and other facilities for the group in Morocco, and (ii) a capex plan to expand BLS existing warehouse facilities and construct greenfield warehouse facilities and logistics platforms in various large cities of the country (the Project).
